raw.query: SELECT w.mean_img_per_s, l.p99_ms FROM provenance.v_dim v JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency l ON v.run_id = l.run_id JOIN provenance.windows w ON v.window_name = w.window_name WHERE v.is_current = true AND v.run_id = 'sweeps:vision_burst1_s1' AND l.sla_metric = 'encoder_delay';
raw.claimed: offered load 116 img/s, encoder delay p99 5013 ms at s=1
raw.evidence: View v_pool_latency records a p99 encoder delay of 5013.37 ms at s=1 (run_id sweeps:vision_burst1_s1) during the burst1 window which has a mean offered load of 116.173 img/s, violating the 1000 ms SLA and confirming no knee.
